blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas also booked its place in the semifinals of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games women’s U-23 3×3 basketball on Thursday with a 22-12 victory over Singapore at Kinjo Futo Station Square. Amyah Espanol and Kennan Ka backed up Kacey dela Rosa during a decisive stretch that allowed Gilas to pull away and beat Singapore in their quarterfinal matchup. Espanol and Ka scored seven points each as the women’s squad joined its men counterpart in the semifinals of the halfcourt event. Earlier, Gilas Men advanced to the semis by […]...
